name: prepflow
description: AI study planning tool: turns a syllabus and notes into a prioritized, revision-aware study plan.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @prepflow/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @prepflow/api && npm run build -w @prepflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @prepflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @prepflow/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @prepflow/shared && npm run test -w @prepflow/api && npm run test -w @prepflow/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @prepflow/api
